# GOG — accessing castle-recapture missions

- Original source: [Siege of Lincoln](https://www.gog.com/forum/robin_hood_legend_of_sherwood/siege_of_lincoln/post3)
- Author / publication: Turon1 and bamspeedy.224; GOG forum.
- Language / date: English; opened 2018-07-01.
- Access: Full thread retrieved directly (4 posts)
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete post-by-post notes (GOG forum thread, not transcribed)

Turon1 wants to replay recapture missions that successful defenses prevent from appearing. bamspeedy.224 describes allowing a defense countdown to expire while choosing another mission, and saving before mission completion to retry the next mission selection.

A follow-up reports that failing Lincoln’s defense eventually exposes Free Lincoln, followed by another defense, and that losing Derby leads back to The Black Castle. The player could not make Leicester’s defense fail and speculates about its campaign role. These are reported branch observations rather than a complete campaign-state specification; the explanation for Leicester remains conjectural.

## Detailed notes

Page facts: GOG.com forum thread "Siege of Lincoln" in the Robin Hood Legend of Sherwood forum; 4 posts; marked "solved" by bamspeedy.224's post; opened July 01, 2018 by Turon1. Retrieved directly on 2026-09-09. Forum posts are not licensed for reproduction; summarised post by post.

### Posts

1. **Turon1** (New User, registered Jul 2018, Czech Republic), posted July 01, 2018, post 1. Has already solved flickering-screen and other technical problems. Enjoys the sieges and reconquering castles with allies. Years ago they failed to save Lincoln (maybe Leicester too) from the Sheriff's armies and had to conquer it back; remembers fog in the recapture-of-Lincoln mission. Now they always succeed in saving both towns, so cannot access those missions. Asks whether there is a way to play the reconquest missions (Lincoln/Leicester) again.
2. **bamspeedy.224** (New User, registered Apr 2013, United States), posted November 18, 2018, post 2, marked as the solution. They failed to defend Derby once but reloaded; had meant to let the failure stand to see what happens; agrees this sounds like "missing missions" not discussed in walkthroughs. Method: pick a different mission when the "Defend __" countdown is down to 0. Sometimes no other choice exists. Tips: play the missions that earn blazons, since those use up turns and bring the counter down (Defend Lincoln has none of these). Save just before clicking the check mark at the end of a mission, because the game chooses the new missions when a mission is completed; if no alternatives appear, reload and end the mission again. Sometimes no reload gives alternatives, since most story missions cannot be skipped and have no fail option.
3. **bamspeedy1** (New User, registered Jan 2019, United States), posted January 12, 2019, post 3. Played again, deliberately doing ambush missions instead of story missions to delay or lose them. Not finished yet, but reports: trying to fail Defend Lincoln, the countdown reset after completing "Wedding and a Funeral", yet it could still be done. Failing "Defend Lincoln" results in the new mission "Free Lincoln" (after "Defend Leicester", another simple defend mission where you just acquire blazons; that one could not be failed, which makes sense because otherwise no castles would remain to launch allied attacks from). After freeing Lincoln it must be defended again, so these missions can repeat multiple times. Failing "Defend Derby" means repeating "The Black Castle".
4. **Turon1**, posted November 14, 2021, post 4. Thanks; had never known about the timer and now understands what the hourglass icons mean.
